camel_example: aliyun vod DescribeVodStorageData --region cn-hangzhou --StorageType OSS --Storage bucket --EndTime '2019-02-01T15:00:00Z' --AppId 'app-1000000' --StartTime '2019-02-01T14:00:00Z' --Region 'cn-shanghai'
description_en: Queries the usage of media asset management, including storage space and outbound storage traffic
description_zh: 调用本接口查询媒资管理（存储空间、存储流出流量）的用量
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-vod-storage-data --start-time 2019-02-01T14:00:00Z --end-time 2019-02-01T15:00:00Z --biz-region cn-shanghai --storage-type OSS --storage bucket --app-id app-1000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVodStorageData

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据结束时间点，需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The storage region. By default, data of all regions is returned. You can specify multiple regions separated by commas (,). Valid values:

cn-shanghai: Shanghai.
cn-beijing: Beijing.
eu-central-1: Germany.
ap-southeast-1: Singapore
parameters.help_zh:
存储地域。默认返回所有地域。支持批量查询，多个区域用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：
cn-shanghai：上海。
cn-beijing：北京。
eu-central-1：德国。
ap-southeast-1：新加坡
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The storage type. Set the value to OSS
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The storage name (Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket name). By default, data of all storage buckets is returned. You can specify multiple storage names separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 存储名称（阿里云OSS存储Bucket名称），默认返回所有存储。支持批量查询，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: storage

parameters.help_en: The application ID. If you have activated the multi-application feature, you can specify this parameter to query the storage usage of a specific application. If you do not specify this parameter, the total storage usage of all applications is returned. You can obtain the value of this parameter from the AppId response parameter of the [CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~) operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113601.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。若已开通多应用，传入此参数，可以查询指定应用下的存储用量。不传，则默认返回所有应用的转码用量总数据。本参数值可以从[CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~)接口的返回参数`AppId`获取。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113601.html
parameters.name: app_id
